title: Adjustments of Hijri Calendar
body: Why the Islamic calendar can not be adjusted? It is necessary to allow the date on Islamic calendar to be adjusted by /- one or two day as it is subject to moon 🌙 sighting in different areas.

title: Alternative Calendar Suggestion
body: Hi Team, i would like to bring your attention to the most important features if alternate calendars which is date adjustment, as you know that most of the alternatives calendars work on lunar, and you're also aware that lunar are not static as compared to solar calendar, so please give a toggle to adjust lunar dates like hijri calendar of +/- 1 or 2 days, so everyone can adjust this according to their region this will make calendar app a comprehensive tool, otherwise we have to use different apps for alternative calendars for authenticity. You may also connect with regional calendars to automatically adjust alternative calendars according to their regions current dates. But i suggest manually adjustment should be provided in both cases. Thanks
